Package cache memoizes the outcome of verifying a credential. A sync client presents the same secret on every request, which otherwise costs a database or identity provider lookup every time. It does not matter what the credential is: an app password, a username and password, a public link token or a signed JWT all go through the same cache. Rejections are cached too, so a client that keeps retrying a stale password is also answered from memory.
